description: Search Government of Canada award notices published on CanadaBuys since August 2022: which supplier won a contract, standing offer or supply arrangement, from which buyer, when, and for how much. Use it to find the incumbent before a re-competition, what similar work has sold for, which contracts end soon, or what a competitor has won. Each notice shows its latest amendment. Returns short summaries; call get_award for full details. With no arguments it lists the most recent awards. The first call downloads about 110 MB and can take a minute.

awarded_after.description: Only contracts awarded on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

awarded_before.description: Only contracts awarded on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

buyer.description: Words from the contracting or end-user organization name, in either language. Public Services and Procurement Canada buys on behalf of other departments, which then appear as end users.

category.description: Procurement categories; an award matching any listed category is returned.

competitive.description: true for competitively awarded contracts only; false for non-competitive awards and advance contract award notices only. Awards with no stated method match neither.

match.description: Whether a notice must contain all query terms or any of them. An explicit OR in the query always applies.

max_value.description: Only awards with a stated value of at most this amount.

min_value.description: Only awards worth at least this amount, in the contract currency (almost always CAD). Above zero, this drops awards with no stated value.

query.description: Keywords searched in titles, descriptions, commodity names, supplier and buyer names, and solicitation and contract numbers. Words match in English and French, ignoring case and accents. Use "double quotes" for an exact phrase, a trailing * for a prefix (engineer*), and uppercase OR between alternatives.

region.description: Text contained in a region of delivery, e.g. "Ontario" or "National Capital Region".

sort.description: Defaults to relevance when a query is given, otherwise newest (by award date).

supplier.description: Words from the winning supplier's legal name, e.g. "Deloitte".

unspsc.description: UNSPSC commodity code or prefix. A segment or family code such as 43000000 or 4323 also matches every code beneath it.

name: search_awards
title: Search federal contract awards
